entities.summary: Buttle Church is a medieval church in Buttle on the Swedish island of Gotland. It is one of the more well-preserved Romanesque churches on Gotland, and contains both a number of medieval furnishings as well as medieval murals. Buttle Church belongs to the Diocese of Visby of the Church of Sweden.
